result.topic_en: Latin notes on a vector field (p, q, r) depending on two variables: the author shows that (p, q, r), taken as orthogonal coordinates, satisfy a minimal-surface equation, reduces to the planar case, and solves the resulting Laplace equation for s in polar-type variables.

items.english: Equation 11 constitutes a surface of minimal area which, by equation (8) or (8'), is at the same time either a sphere or developable into a plane, which cannot happen unless the surface itself is a plane, and hence a and b are constants.
